tristan.title: Flag of Tristan da Cunha

colors.note: British Blue Ensign; the South Atlantic.

desc:
- A Blue Ensign with the coat of arms of Tristan da Cunha
- The arms feature Tristan longboats, a Tristan rock lobster, and a naval crown, with the motto 'Our faith is our strength'
- **Construction:** a Blue Ensign (1:2) with the Union Flag in the upper-hoist canton. The territorial arms appear in the fly half
trivia:
- Tristan da Cunha uses the Union Jack as a British Overseas Territory
- One of the most remote inhabited places in the world
- Smallest population of any British territory
